per_rule.rule: S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty.
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Account_No must match the Account_No stored in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N.
Account_No must be stored as exactly 4 digits.
Name should use consistent personal-name casing and should not be fully lowercase or fully uppercase, while allowing cultural particles such as bin, binte, s/o, and d/o.
ID_No must follow the dominant format of one uppercase letter, followed by 7 digits, and ending with one uppercase letter.
ID_No should be unique per customer record.
Race must use the canonical values Chinese, Malay, or Indian.
Gender must use the canonical values Male or Female.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value.
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive.
Age should not be below 13 for this customer dataset.
Contact_No should not be null.
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number, allowing local 8-digit format or numbers prefixed with country code 65, and must contain 7 to 15 digits overall with only valid phone punctuation.
Email must match the standard basic email structure with exactly one @ symbol and no spaces.
Country must use the canonical value Singapore.
Street_Name should use consistent title-style casing rather than all-uppercase values.
Postal_Code must be stored as exactly 6 digits.
If Name contains the particle 'Bin' or 's/o', Gender must be Male; if Name contains 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender must be Female.
If Country is Singapore, Postal_Code must be a 6-digit Singapore postal code.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No must match the ID stored in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Name should be consistent with Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name after normalizing case and spacing; obvious truncation or materially different names should be flagged.
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
